message: Vector Rebel 3.2.76: two layouts (User Interface and owner-only Master Interface), current administrator roster viewer, midnight release/roster/error checks, and master error alerts.
releaseNotes: User Interface contains Tour PPE, After Fire, PPE Form, Daily Captain Check, Settings, and read-only Master List. Owner-paired Master Interface can preview the exact User layout and return to the expanded Master interface (SCBA Airpacks, Apparatus Check, Manage Master List, Errors & Alerts, Report Problem, update checks). Public and self-enrolled installations remain on the User Interface; a visual mode switch does not grant backend permissions. Shared Master List uses the existing centrally published, authenticated, read-only roster endpoint, with latest-version/last-synced status and manual refresh. Midnight LOCAL time and tab-resume checks refresh roster, pending error reports, version availability and master inbox without changing or resubmitting Vector forms. The userscript detects new releases and offers an installer; Tampermonkey auto-install timing is separately managed by the browser extension and cannot be forced at exactly midnight from a website script. Errors continue to queue and send automatically to Rebel Command; master view polls a newly staged owner-only, read-only error inbox every two minutes while the browser is available, with explicit opt-in desktop notifications. Remote/unattended and offline alerts require a separate notification service. 3.2.75 temporary captain-date assignment logic and all previous SCBA queue versions remain supported.
